content:
Reliance on ChatGPT for quick visual searches can now use a new gesture to add photos to conversations even faster. Here's how.

ChatGPT makes it easier to attach recent photos to conversations

Although iOS's Visual Intelligence feature has been around for nearly two years, it still only supports newer iPhone models and is not available in every region.

For users who rely on ChatGPT for similar visual searches, attaching a photo used to require tapping the plus button first, then tapping "Photos," and then picking an image from the album.

Although the process is not overly complicated, OpenAI added a handy gesture last week that makes adding recent photos quicker.

OpenAI's Adam Fry mentioned on X that users can now long-press the plus button on the left side of the prompt box, which will bring up the four most recent photos.

Users can pick a photo to add to the conversation, then ask a question or incorporate it into their prompt.

This new gesture, along with several other ChatGPT improvements, was rolled out last week, including more accurate awareness of the current time, faster loading and navigation for long conversations on the web version, and clearer interface prompts while waiting for a network connection.

Have you used AI for visual searches? Feel free to share in the comments section.
